title: IntakeForm
description: An IntakeForm declares the fields shown when creating or updating a governance entity (Data Product, Domain, Glossary Term) and which of those fields are required. Required fields are enforced identically at the API and UI layers so both contracts match.

targetEntityType.description: Entity types supported by IntakeForm today.

fieldKind.description: Whether a required field refers to a native entity attribute or a custom property defined via the Type system.

requiredField.description: A single field declared as required by this IntakeForm.

fieldPath.description: Path to the field on the entity. Native paths are simple attribute names (e.g., 'dataProductType'). Custom property paths look like 'extension.<propertyName>'.

fieldLabel.description: Human-friendly label used in validation error messages and on the intake form UI.

errorMessage.description: Optional override for the validation error message when this field is missing.

intakeFormField.description: A field included in this IntakeForm.

fieldPath.description: Path to the field on the entity. Native paths are simple attribute names (e.g., 'dataProductType'). Custom property paths look like 'extension.<propertyName>'.

fieldLabel.description: Human-friendly label used on the intake form UI and in validation error messages.

fieldKind.description: Whether a form field refers to a native entity attribute or a custom property defined via the Type system.

required.description: Whether this field must have a value before the entity can be created or updated.

errorMessage.description: Optional override for the validation error message when a required field is missing.

fullyQualifiedName.description: Fully qualified name of the IntakeForm.

description.description: Description of what governance policy this IntakeForm enforces.

entityType.description: The entity type this IntakeForm applies to. Only one IntakeForm may exist per entityType.

enabled.description: Whether this IntakeForm is currently enforced. Disabling is a soft toggle that lets admins pause validation without deleting the form.

formFields.description: Fields included in this IntakeForm. Fields with required=true are enforced on top of the schema-required fields.

requiredFields.description: Deprecated compatibility view of the required entries in formFields.
requiredFields.$comment: @deprecated Use formFields and set required=true on fields that must be populated

updatedAt.description: Last update time corresponding to the new version of the entity in Unix epoch time milliseconds.

href.description: Link to the resource corresponding to this entity.

changeDescription.description: Change that lead to this version of the entity.

incrementalChangeDescription.description: Incremental change that lead to this version of the entity.

deleted.description: When `true` indicates the entity has been soft deleted.
